target_customer: Data, finance, RevOps, customer success and business operations teams at mid sized and public companies that report to leadership and clients in slide decks
problem: Teams spend countless hours copying numbers from BI tools and warehouses into slide decks and documents.
product_category: Automated reporting and AI slide generation connected to BI tools

founders.name: Nabil Jallouli
founders.background_notes: Background not stated on the YC page.

founders.background_notes: Background not stated on the YC page.

founders.background_notes: Background not stated on the YC page.

technical_complexity.rationale: Requires connectors to many BI tools and warehouses, template handling for PowerPoint and Google Slides, and scheduled refresh. Mostly integration engineering, with LLM features added later.

defensibility.rationale: Deep integrations with customer BI stacks and recurring reports built on company templates create some lock in, while the core idea of pushing data into slides is copyable.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No incumbent is reported to have shipped an equivalent that displaced Rollstack by the research date. A vendor comparison names Matik as a content automation alternative.

market_need_then: Rollstack's own pitch cites organizations relying on slide decks for leadership, client and partner reporting while preparation consumes many hours. Early customers named on its site include SoFi, Zillow and Whirlpool (YC listing) and later SoFi, Tripadvisor and CarGurus.

branding.domain_note: Uses rollstack.com; an earlier rollstack.io domain appears in third party records. No acquisition story found.

identity.voice_and_tone: Direct B2B voice about traceable numbers and recurring reports.

brand_strength.rationale: No press or community evidence about the brand itself was found. The name is clear and fits the category, but there is no sign it drove growth.

outcome_analysis: Rollstack raised a small seed after YC W23 and an 11 million dollar Series A led by Insight Partners in October 2024, with named enterprise customers and a product that has moved from BI to slides toward an AI slides platform with an MCP server. No acquisition, shutdown or layoffs were found. Its progress rests on a repeatable B2B reporting use case and integration depth, though revenue is not disclosed.
notes: Seed date conflicts: aggregators say September 2023, while the company post has been reported as dated July 2024, so only the year is recorded. Series A date varies (CB Insights Aug 2024, company and Insight Oct 2024); Oct 2024 used. Total raised reported as 11M to 13.3M across aggregators. Founded year is 2022 per a SourceForge listing; other profiles say 2023. No dated competitor sources near 2022 found, so the list is empty. Founder education and prior employers not found.
